dedupe_keys.name: arcep ma connexion internet fixed internet access technologies available by address

description: Ma connexion internet is Arcep's search engine that tells French residents which fixed internet access technologies are available at their address and at what maximum speeds, and this open dataset publishes its data. For every address or building in France it gives the eligibility to DSL on copper, cable, fibre to the home, fixed 4G, fixed wireless and satellite offers by operator, with speed classes, built from data that operators must provide to Arcep, and it adds aggregated statistics by commune, département and region. Coverage: all of France, address and building level, quarterly releases since September 2019. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files (about 43 MB of listed resources, with larger linked archives) and PDF documentation on data.gouv.fr, plus the search site maconnexioninternet.arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: availability is declared by operators, not measured; speeds are theoretical classes; the address base follows the national address register and changes between releases. Simulation uses: an inventory of which fixed networks serve each place for exposure of broadband service to hazards, planning of fibre roll-out, and equity of access in resilience studies. Related records: the Arcep FTTH deployment data give fibre roll-out progress, and Mon Réseau Mobile gives mobile coverage.
